title: Cube's Craft - Mob Tweaks
description: A datapack/resource pack expansion for Cube's Craft that enhances some mobs.
body:
![Cube's Craft - Mob Tweaks Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb2b60cf76f2838fe353aff69ec9666e25629363.png)

THIS REQUIRES CUBE'S CRAFT TO FUNCTION PROPERLY

Make sure that THIS PACK is ABOVE the base Cube's Craft pack.

THIS IS A DATAPACK AND A RESOURCE PACK

Put the resources zip into your resource packs folder, and the data zip into your world's datapack folder.

ADDING THIS DATAPACK TO A WORLD AFTER IT IS CREATED MAY BREAK THINGS

This is an expansion for Cube's Craft focused on enhancing certain mobs. The changes include the following:

- Temperate and warm chickens have tails and a more detailed model
- Cave spiders now drop stingers
  - Takes the place of spider eyes in brewing potions of poison
  - Regular spider eyes (which, on the technical side of things, replace fermented spider eyes) serve the same purpose as fermented spider eyes in brewing
- Frogs now drop Frog Legs
  - Replace Rabbit's Feet
  - Used to brew Potions of Leaping
  - Can be eaten 
- Mob variants
  - Dairy cows in villages
  - Muddy pigs in swamps
  - April Fools space cows in The End (Creative only)
  - Hoglin-themed pigs in the nether (Creative only)
  - Skeleton wolves in deserts (Creative only)
- Polar bears and wither skeletons are bigger
  - Comes with a new, scaled up texture so they are pixel consistent
- Rabbits and cats are slightly bigger for pixel consistency
  
- Armor stands have arms (this may get moved to its own pack eventually)

Check out the other expansions [here](https://modrinth.com/collection/4yhJ4w2t)
